content:
We (@Allan Jie @ByronW @Zheng Yuan @Huajian Xin @Thomas Zhu @Zeyu Zheng @RexWang and many coauthors not using Zulip) are excited to announce Seed-Prover 1.5.

It is trained via large-scale agentic reinforcement learning to become a strong and efficient prover.
It proved 580/660 putnam problems, 33/100 fate-x (Formal Algebra Theorem Evaluation - Extra Hard), 11/12 putnam2025 problems, and some trivial Erdos problems with limited computational resources.
Please check our details at our technical report pdf.

Towards contributing to real math progress, we are working on autoformalization and open-conjectures. See you at Seed Prover 2.0.
Discussion: #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Seed Prover 1.5 proves 11 / 12 Putnam 2025 in 9 hours
